items.title: Remote Sensing for Sustainable Land Management
items.description: This book presents a focused orientation on the development and use of RS-based indicators and monitoring tools. Remote Sensing (RS)-based tools for the monitoring and reporting of national progress on land degradation and desertification have been developed and adopted by countries party to United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification (UNCCD). Each participating country is supposed to provide country-specific information for performance review in achieving the goals of sustainable land management. This is mostly done through identified set of indicators where the application of RS has emerged as a top necessity. This book illustrates methodological approaches for providing timely information at local to global scale. New approaches and tools that may be integrated for such monitoring and reporting will be placed in this book. This book will be a useful resource among professionals and practitioners working to achieve sustainable development goals (SDGs).

items.title: Vibe Coding Done Right
items.description:
Vibe coding is redefining how enterprises imagine, prototype, and deliver applications bridging the gap between business stakeholders and developers. This book introduces organizations to both the promise and the pitfalls of vibe coding, cutting through the hype to show where it creates tangible value. From breaking down the anatomy of modern applications in plain terms to exploring how AI-assisted development platforms such as Google AI Studio, Codex, Cursor, and other modern coding tools accelerate delivery , readers gain a practical framework for balancing rapid innovation with enterprise-grade governance, security, and scalability. Business leaders will see how vibe coding can reduce IT backlogs and speed up proof-of-concepts, while developers and engineering teams will learn how to adopt it as a force multiplier rather than a replacement. 
 Moving beyond surface-level tutorials, this book provides a structured, step-by-step guide: from preparing teams with the right workflows and guardrails, to building working prototypes, adding features, and scaling responsibly. It also maps the broader ecosystem, introduces alternative enterprise-ready platforms, and highlights when organizations should transition from prototypes to production-grade systems. With actionable checklists, do’s and don’ts, and a clear roadmap for safe adoption, this book empowers enterprises to harness vibe coding as a catalyst for innovation while avoiding common traps and ensuring long-term success. 
 You Will: 
 Plan workflows, write clear prompts, and avoid common AI coding pitfalls. 
 Learn how to build, ship, and refine apps using modern AI-assisted development platforms, including Google AI Studio, Codex, Cursor, and more. 
 Explore real-world use cases from enterprise prototypes and business demos to student projects and startup experiments. 
 This book is for: Developers, Enterprise architects, and engineering teams

items.title: Practical Game Theory for Real-World Decisions
items.description:
Every day, we make decisions whose outcomes depend not only on what we choose, but also on what others choose. Whether negotiating a salary, competing in business, managing workplace relationships, making family decisions, or simply navigating traffic, success often depends on understanding how other people think, respond, and adapt. 

This is the world of game theory, the science of strategic decision-making. 

While game theory has transformed economics, business, politics, and public policy, most books on the subject remain highly mathematical and intended for academic audiences. Practical Game Theory for Real-World Decisions takes a different approach. It explains the essential ideas of game theory through plain language, relatable stories, and practical examples, without equations or formal proofs. 

Across more than 60 concise chapters, you'll discover powerful concepts including Nash equilibrium, dominant strategies, commitment, signalling, bargaining, information asymmetry, cooperation, competition, negotiation, and decision-making under uncertainty. Each chapter introduces a strategic principle and demonstrates how it applies to situations readers encounter every day. 

Rather than teaching game theory as an academic discipline, this book develops a practical way of thinking. It helps readers recognize incentives, anticipate the actions of others, avoid common strategic mistakes, and identify opportunities for cooperation as well as competition. 

Whether you are a student, professional, entrepreneur, manager, or simply someone who wants to make better decisions, this book offers a practical toolkit for thinking more clearly in an increasingly interconnected and uncertain world.

items.title: Science, Engineering Management and Information Technology
IT-Sicherheitsrecht kompakt
items.description:
Wie bleiben Organisationen in Europa rechtskonform und zugleich resilient? Dieses kompakte Handbuch führt verständlich in das Recht der IT‑Sicherheit ein und ordnet die zentralen europäischen und deutschen Vorgaben ein. Im Fokus stehen die NIS‑2‑Richtlinie, der Cyber Resilience Act und die KI‑Verordnung sowie deren nationale Ausgestaltung – mit klaren Anforderungen an Risikomanagement, Technik‑ und Organisationsmaßnahmen und Aufsicht. Besonders praxisrelevant: die Melde‑ und Berichtspflichten bei Sicherheitsvorfällen mit Frühwarnung binnen 24 Stunden, Folgemeldung nach 72 Stunden und Abschlussbericht je nach Bewältigungsstand. Querschnittskapitel erläutern Datenschutz (DSGVO/BDSG), Signatur‑ und Vertrauensdienste nach eIDAS 2.0, Straf‑ und Arbeitsrecht sowie den Schutz geistigen Eigentums.
 
Ein Überblick zu Normen, Standards und Zertifizierungen – von ISO/IEC 27001 und ISO/IEC 27002 über IT‑Grundschutz bis zu branchenspezifischen Sicherheitsstandards – zeigt, wie sich der „Stand der Technik“ konkret fassen lässt. BSI und ENISA werden als zentrale Akteure eingeordnet; die Rolle des Informationssicherheitsbeauftragten wird mit Anforderungen, Unabhängigkeit und Aufgabenprofil greifbar. Das Werk bietet kompakte Leitplanken, Checklisten‑artige Übersichten zu Verantwortlichkeiten, Sanktionen und Fristen sowie zahlreiche Verweise zur Vertiefung. Das interdisziplinäre Team am Fraunhofer SIT verbindet juristische Präzision mit technischer Praxis – ideal für Informationssicherheitsbeauftragte, Compliance‑ und IT‑Verantwortliche in Unternehmen, Verwaltung und Forschung.
 
Dies ist ein Open-Access-Buch.

items.title: Computer Vision – ECCV 2026

items.title: Business Process Management Forum
items.description:
This book constitutes the proceedings of the BPM Forum held at the 24th International Conference on Business Process Management, BPM 2026, which took place in Toronto, Canada, during September/October 2026. 

Contributions presented at the BPM Forum include novel applications, early-stage results, or creative perspectives on known problems. They cover a diverse and timely set of topics, reflecting the evolving socio-technical and AI-enhanced landscape of BPM. The topics explored include business process management; robotic process automation; process modeling-, execution-, monitoring-, and simulation; object-centric process mining; business intelligence; and large language models. 

The 24 full papers included in this book were carefully reviewed and selected from a total of 169 submissions. The papers were organized in topical sections as follows: Foundations; Engineering; and Management.
